_doc: P0 (round-2 doac-vte + sglt2-ckd): 'registry-first systematic search' is contradicted by our own audit trail on multiple topics — the AACT registry run FAILED (RAN_ERROR) and/or PubMed was queried with UID/PMID-anchored strings for already-known trials. A fetch of a named identifier is not a search (standing memory law). This classifies how each topic's included set was actually assembled. PRELIMINARY: the 5 PMID_ENUMERATION are from explicit protocol 'UID-anchored' wording; the 21 UNCLEAR need the verbatim PubMed query strings checked, but the TWO independently audited among them (doac-vte, sglt2-ckd) BOTH proved PMID-enumeration, so the true PMID_ENUMERATION count is likely far higher.

RAN_ERROR_rendered_as_run.note: Registry-first (AACT) = RAN_ERROR; the source_status table shows it, but the search narrative still presents the topic as registry-first. RAN_ERROR must never be rendered as a completed search (extends the audit-22 NOT_RUN gate limb to RAN_ERROR).

PMID_ENUMERATION_explicit.note: protocol Search section explicitly says UID-anchored queries for the named trials — known-item retrieval, cannot discover an unknown eligible trial.

needs_verbatim_query_check.note: protocol prose did not state the query type; the verbatim PubMed queries must be inspected. doac-vte and sglt2-ckd (independently audited) both turned out PMID-enumeration, so expect most of these to be enumeration too.

headline: At least 11 of 32 topics do NOT have a genuine executed concept search (6 registry-first RAN_ERROR-rendered + 5 explicit PMID-enumeration); the 21 unclear likely include many more (2 of 2 audited among them were enumeration). Every PMID-enumeration topic must say so on the page and must not claim a registry-first/systematic search.
reachability_verdict: REACHABLE-AND-MISSED: the signal (Registry-first (AACT)=RAN_ERROR) was sitting in our own committed source_status the whole time; no instrument classified provenance or flagged RAN_ERROR-rendered-as-run. Round-1's lens was per-page arithmetic reproduction, not foundational search/registration/measure-identity — which is why round-2's different lens found these.
